SOOPPIY DOCS — TRADING GATEWAY SETUP

Connect OKX

How to create the API credentials at OKX and connect them on the Accounts page. shadow first — live rollout in progress

1Before you start

  • An account at OKX that has finished the venue's identity verification — an unverified account can create a key but cannot trade with it.
  • Two-factor authentication switched on at OKX. Every venue asks for a 2FA code (and often an email confirmation) at the moment you create the key.
  • This page open next to the venue's site, and somewhere safe to hold the secret for the minute between creating it and connecting it.

2Availability and local rules

Not available to residents of the United States. Availability elsewhere varies — OKX operates licensed entities in some markets (including Singapore) and restricts others.

Sooppiy does not decide who may use a venue — the venue's own KYC does, and your local law does. Connecting a gateway here does not make a venue available to you, and a venue you cannot legally use will simply refuse your key. This is factual guidance, not legal advice; access rules change, so confirm on the venue's own terms page for your country.

3What you need

  • API key
  • API secret
  • API passphrase (chosen when the key is created)
Grant TRADE permission only — never withdrawal. Use the venue's IP allowlist when it offers one. Start small. Your keys are encrypted at rest (AES-GCM) on Sooppiy's server and are never shown again after you save them.
IP restriction — leave it unset for now. Some venues let you lock a key to one server address. Sooppiy is moving its hosting region, and a key pinned to the old address would stop working the moment it moves. One consequence worth diarising: Binance and Bybit disable an unrestricted key's trading permission after 90 days, so plan to revisit the key then.

4Create your credentials at OKX

  1. Log in at okx.com → profile icon → API keys → Create API key.
  2. You choose the passphrase yourself at creation — OKX signs every request with it, so Sooppiy needs all three values.
  3. Permissions: Trade (plus Read). Never Withdraw.
  4. For shadow comparison, switch OKX into Demo trading mode first and create a demo API key there — demo and real keys are separate.
The secret is shown exactly once, at creation. If you close that screen without copying it you cannot recover it — you have to delete the key and make a new one. Sooppiy never shows it again either, once saved.

5Where each value goes

At OKX it is calledPaste it into Sooppiy's field
API keyAPI key
Secret keyAPI secret
PassphraseAPI passphrase (chosen when the key is created)

6Connect it on the Accounts page

  1. Open Accounts → Trading gateway.
  2. Pick your region (ordering only — every broker stays available) and choose OKX.
  3. Paste the credentials from step 2.
  4. Read and accept the live-trading terms — required even if you only plan to use shadow.
  5. Press Connect gateway. The account starts in paper mode: nothing is sent to OKX yet.
  6. Switch the account to shadow (recommended first) or live on the account card.

7After you connect

  1. The gateway appears under Connected gateways with a health line. Key-pair venues show “credentials on file” — normal, it means there is no session to probe.
  2. Your automation rules do not switch by themselves. A rule only reaches OKX when you set that rule's account type to shadow or live.
  3. Start in shadow and read the Drift records panel for a few days before considering live.
  4. To revoke access at any time, delete the key at OKX — that stops every order instantly, whatever Sooppiy is set to.

8What each mode does with OKX

ModeWhat happens
paperpaper / simulator — every trade stays on Sooppiy's internal ledger. OKX is never contacted.
shadowshadow — fills stay simulated and the same order is ALSO sent to OKX's demo trading environment (the simulated-trading channel) for comparison; the drift is journalled. Demo keys are separate from real ones.
livelive — not yet open for OKX: the venue is in its shadow rollout soak, and live routing is refused with an explicit message until Sooppiy enables it platform-wide. Your rules can run in shadow meanwhile. Newly enabled venues also carry a $1,000 per-order limit at first (over-limit orders are refused, never resized).
Whatever mode you use, the Broker orders and Drift records panels at the bottom of the Accounts page show what OKX actually confirmed next to what the ledger assumed — differences are surfaced loudly, never auto-corrected.

9Venue notes

  • Spot only for now, USDT pairs (BTC-USDT style).
  • Sooppiy pins market buys to base-currency sizing — the configured amount is coins, never a USDT spend.

10Troubleshooting

SymptomWhat it means / what to do
“credentials are missing or cannot be decrypted”The stored key can no longer be read (for example after a server key rotation). Reconnect the broker with fresh credentials.
“live-trading terms have not been accepted”Accept the terms for this broker on the Accounts page — consent is recorded per broker.
“not yet enabled for live orders on this platform”The venue is still in its shadow rollout. Shadow works today; live opens when the soak completes.
code 50105 / “Passphrase incorrect”The passphrase Sooppiy stored differs from the one set at key creation. Reconnect the broker and re-enter all three values.
code 50111 / “Invalid OK-ACCESS-KEY”Usually a real key while the venue expects a demo key (or the reverse) — the two environments have separate keys.
